title: Last Time in New York
cn: 第 3 集 · 最后一次在纽约
novel:
Lily [[discovered|discover]] that Ted had a [[list|list]] of things he wanted to do before [[moving|move]] to Chicago. The list included visiting his favorite restaurants, saying goodbye to old friends, and walking through Central Park one last time.

Ted explained that he wanted to [[complete|complete]] everything on the list before leaving New York forever. He felt [[nostalgic|nostalgic]] about the city where he had spent so many wonderful years. Lily offered to help him finish the list.

Meanwhile, Robin and Barney [[realized|realize]] that they had very little time left before their [[relatives|relative]] arrived for the wedding. They wanted to [[spend|spend]] their final hours of peace doing something special together. They decided to have a quiet dinner and talk about their future.

Barney [[admitted|admit]] that he was going to miss his old life as a single man. Robin laughed and said she would miss her freedom too. But they both agreed that being together was more [[precious|precious]] than anything else.

Ted and Lily went through the list together. They [[visited|visit]] Ted's favorite bookstore, ate at a diner they loved, and sat on their old apartment steps. Ted felt a wave of [[sadness|sadness]] as he [[recalled|recall]] all the memories they had shared.

Lily told Ted that he should not have any [[regrets|regret]] about leaving. She said that Chicago would bring new adventures and new friends. Ted smiled and thanked her for being such a good friend. They promised to [[cherish|cherish]] every memory they had made in New York.
